C0800.title: Drive System Voltage Low
C0800.description: The chassis control module has detected that the supply voltage is below the operating threshold required for ABS, ESP or steering systems. Many chassis functions are limited or disabled until the voltage returns to a normal range.

C0805.title: Steering Angle Sensor Calibration
C0805.description: The chassis or stability control module reports that the steering angle sensor has not been calibrated or that the calibration data has been lost. ESP requires a calibrated zero position and is disabled until calibration is performed.

causes.label: Calibration required after battery disconnect or repair

C0810.title: Air Suspension Compressor Circuit
C0810.description: The air suspension compressor motor circuit reports an electrical fault. Levelling is disabled.

C0815.title: Air Suspension Compressor Overtemperature
C0815.description: The air suspension compressor has been disabled to protect against overheating, typically after a slow leak.

causes.label: Slow leak in air spring or line

C0820.title: Air Suspension Height Sensor Front Left
C0820.description: The front left ride height sensor reports an implausible or missing signal.

C0821.title: Air Suspension Height Sensor Front Right
C0821.description: The front right ride height sensor reports an implausible or missing signal.

C0822.title: Air Suspension Height Sensor Rear Left
C0822.description: The rear left ride height sensor reports an implausible or missing signal.

C0823.title: Air Suspension Height Sensor Rear Right
C0823.description: The rear right ride height sensor reports an implausible or missing signal.

C0825.title: Steering Effort Sensor Range/Performance
C0825.description: The electric power steering module has detected that the torque (effort) sensor signal is out of the expected range. Steering assist is reduced or disabled.

causes.label: Sensor element aged beyond calibration window

C0827.title: Steering Effort Sensor Stuck
C0827.description: The power steering module has detected that the torque sensor signal does not change despite steering input — the sensor appears stuck. Assist is disabled to avoid uncontrolled steering torque.

C0830.title: Steering Wheel Angle Sensor Center Position Not Learned
C0830.description: The chassis control module has not stored a valid center (zero) position for the steering wheel angle sensor. ESP, lane assist and electric power steering may be limited until calibration is performed.

causes.label: Sensor calibration not performed after replacement

C0840.title: Air Suspension Solenoid Valve Circuit
C0840.description: One of the level control solenoid valves reports an electrical fault. The corresponding axle cannot be levelled.

C0850.title: Active Damping Control Front Left
C0850.description: The front left adjustable damper reports an electrical fault.

C0851.title: Active Damping Control Front Right
C0851.description: The front right adjustable damper reports an electrical fault.

C0852.title: Active Damping Control Rear Left
C0852.description: The rear left adjustable damper reports an electrical fault.

C0853.title: Active Damping Control Rear Right
C0853.description: The rear right adjustable damper reports an electrical fault.

C0860.title: Trailer Stability Assist Performance
C0860.description: The trailer stability assist function detects implausible trailer sway response or sensor input.

C0870.title: Adaptive Cruise Control Brake Request Performance
C0870.description: A brake request from adaptive cruise control or AEB cannot be executed within the expected response time.

causes.label: Hydraulic block slow to build pressure
